name: Jean-Jacques Henner

summary.text: Jean-Jacques Henner was a French painter, noted for his use of sfumato and chiaroscuro in painting nudes, religious subjects and portraits.

17492042: La Liseuse is an oil-on-canvas painting by French artist Jean-Jacques Henner. It is sometimes also known as Marie-Madeleine Lisant and it is Henner’s most famous work.
99432889: Woman on a Black Divan, also known simply as Recumbent Woman is an oil on canvas painting by the French artist Jean-Jacques Henner, from 1869. It is one of the Henner paintings of the Musée des Beaux-Arts of Mulhouse.
104443881: Bara is a painting by Jean-Jacques Henner exhibited at the Salon of 1882 and today part of the collection at the Petit Palais in Paris. It depicts a Republican boy-hero of the French Revolution, Joseph Bara, killed by the Vendeans in 1793.
106348950: Alsace, She Waits is an oil on canvas painting by Jean-Jacques Henner, from 1871. It is held in the Musée national Jean-Jacques Henner, in Paris.
121434892: Herodias is a painting by Jean-Jacques Henner completed around 1887. It is held at the Musée national Jean-Jacques Henner, in Paris.
138491657: Salome, a later variant is an oil on canvas painting by the French painter Jean-Jacques Henner, from 1904. It depicts Salome, a figure from the New Testament.
